answer: Operator-Linked Quota Escrow. Each agent identity draws from an operator quota; a quartz timestamped challenge per new identity forces the operator to lock escrowed funds proportional to its total identities. Duplicate behavior clusters trigger a beacon audit that traces shared infrastructure. On confirmation, the operator's entire escrow is slashed and the operator's remaining quota frozen, while individual wallets stay intact. Attacker cost: full escrow loss plus a plume of frozen quota across all identities,
